_note: Active-repo 4-surface index lifecycle (Spec B §4.2). NO PATH FIELDS EXIST BY DESIGN — the active repo root is resolved structurally from lib/repo_context.py, never from a list here. Only thresholds and toggles; memory thresholds live in `memory`. lock_ttl_minutes must outlive the longest build cap plus summarizer_healthcheck.wait_s.

summarizer_healthcheck._note: gates jcodemunch builds and jdocmunch builds of a doc index with vectors (jdocmunch_embed); probes <ollama>/api/tags; <ollama> = OLLAMA_HOST (settings.user.json env) else http://127.0.0.1:11434. A "url" key here overrides it.

memory._note: L6 OOM guard. Tier comes from state/mem-pressure.json (memwatch); missing/stale = ok. defer_surfaces are deferred (DEFERRED, no failure count) at defer_at or worse; dox always runs. fallback_min_avail_mb gates graphify only when no tier file exists (sentinel not installed); it is tuned for a ~30 GB box and scales by MemTotal/30000 on smaller ones, never below fallback_floor_mb. Every builder runs in its own capped scope where systemd-run and the user bus exist.
